review.method: Viewed every linked overview sheet in order and inspected native-resolution source frames 00000–00001, including the opening HUD state.

evidence.cue: Selected champion is visible in river.
Selected champion reaches the river brush edge.

events.uncertainty: The first sample is a black/obscured frame; movement onset precedes the first visible sample by an unknown amount.

cases.reason: No active cooldown counter is clearly visible in initial HUD; slots show cost or unavailable state.
Slot numerals are costs; no centered countdown is observed.

cases.scope: The view changes away from the river to a ward/brush scene while subsequent selected-player views continue at another location; distinguish this view transition from the player moving before it.

evidence.cue: Selected champion remains at river brush edge.
Overview shows a different area with pings/ward and no selected champion in scene.

cases.forbidden_claim: The view transition does not prove the selected player was stationary or teleported.
cases.reason: The viewport changes within the cited scope; this observation is independent of whether the selected player also moves.
No other champion cast is established in sampled views.
No recall bar or attempt is visible.
Only overview sampling was inspected and rapid activity cannot be ruled out; no complete native review of the full scope was performed.

unknown_intervals.reason: Selected champion is not visible in the gameplay scene after the view changes; pings and ward area are visible.

notes: Source-only visual review. Prior exposure to a general League annotation task is disclosed; no current candidate recognition predictions, detector outputs, caches, other labels, or model outputs were viewed. Candidate-selection neighborhoods may have historical exposure as stated in the instructions. Overview sampling does not prove absence of rapid actions; quiet is left unresolved unless the required complete native review was performed.
